elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: no such approval shall be required for Client's assignment to an affiliate

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights ... without the prior written approval of the other party

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: Client's approval of any assignment or transfer by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: TrueLink shall not assign or transfer to a competitor of Client

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: A change of control of Client ... shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate this Agreement

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: Vendor-side successor assignment still needs "prior written approval"; no notice mechanic added

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: Client's approval of any assignment or transfer by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld

reasons: All six atomic preferred elements are expressly present: Customer consent-free affiliate and successor (merger/acquisition/substantially-all-assets) assignment, Vendor assignment gated on Customer approval, that approval subject to a reasonableness standard, an absolute bar on assignment to a Customer competitor, and an express statement that Customer change of control is neither an assignment nor a Vendor termination trigger.
Deletion of the "financially responsible" qualifier is required to reach the preferred position (unqualified affiliate assignment) and is not an extra change.

Edits are confined to the assignment sentence plus one concise added sentence; Term and Termination paragraphs are untouched, and the mutual approval requirement remains effective with no undefined terms or dangling mechanics.
Fallback is not independently satisfied (no mutual written-notice successor right), but the locked target is preferred and preferred is complete, so no further redline is warranted.
